# osc_cdn_site (Resource)

Puts OSC's CDN in front of a service instance, a My App or a My Page, and serves it at `cdn_url`. Requires the PROFESSIONAL plan, and the workspace must be allowed to use the CDN.

Set exactly one origin: `service_id` and `instance_name` for a service instance (only services on the platform's allowlist, today `minio-minio`, where only public-read buckets are accelerated), `app_id` for a My App, or `page_id` for a public My Page.

The CDN caches by the origin's cache headers. Do not send presigned URLs through it: it can keep serving them after they expire. A site costs tokens per GB served, per 1,000 requests and per day.

Every attribute replaces the site when changed. Creating waits until the site is active.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Serve the public-read buckets of a MinIO instance through the CDN.
resource "osc_cdn_site" "media" {
  service_id    = "minio-minio"
  instance_name = osc_instance.storage.name
}

# Put the CDN in front of a My App. It caches what the app's headers allow.
resource "osc_cdn_site" "web" {
  app_id = osc_my_app.web.id
}

output "media_cdn_url" {
  value = osc_cdn_site.media.cdn_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) Id of a My App origin.
- `instance_name` (String) Name of an instance origin. Set with `service_id`.
- `page_id` (String) Id of a My Page origin. A page behind basic auth cannot be accelerated.
- `service_id` (String) Service id of an instance origin, e.g. `minio-minio`. Set with `instance_name`.

### Read-Only

- `cdn_url` (String) The URL the CDN serves the origin at.
- `id` (String) The CDN site id. Use it with `terraform import`.
- `status` (String) The site's status: `active` once created. A site the platform has `suspended` is resumed on the next apply.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <site_id>
terraform import osc_cdn_site.media <site_id>
```
